Vienna VA Data

Planning & zoning

What comes before the town’s boards.

Cases heard by the Town of Vienna’s planning and land-use boards since 2013: signs, fences, new buildings, variances, and everything else that needs approval before it gets built. From the town’s public records.

1,334cases
624meetings
7boards

How to read this list

The Planning Commission reviews development plans and the comprehensive plan. The Board of Zoning Appeals decides variances and appeals. The Board of Architectural Review approves signs and building exteriors. The Windover Heights Board of Review covers the town’s historic district. The town’s system records what was on each agenda; the outcome of a case is in the meeting minutes, linked on each row where published.

2017-08-09 PC16-020 Request for the Planning Commission’s recommendation on a final plat for a proposed re-subdivision of 4-lot existing lots 77, 78, 79, and 80 located at 101, 103, and 201 Mashie Drive as well as 701 Maple Drive into 6 new lots in the RS-16 zone and two waivers of subdivision requirements. This is a RS-16, by-right, low-density, single-family residential application. It is consistent with the land-use map in the 2015 Comprehensive Plan update and current Zoning Map. The 6-lot proposal maintains the current RS-16 (Single Family Detached Residential) zone. The proposed development meets all zoning ordinance requirements of the RS-16 (Single Family Detached Residential) district as detailed in the attached staff report. However, the applicant has requested two waivers as provided for in Section 17-12 of the Towns subdivision ordinance. The project as proposed needs a waiver from Town Council for the lot deviation of more than 3 feet to accommodate needed grading/fill to build the cul-de-sac. A waiver is also being requested for the required construction of sidewalk along Follin Lane SE. Departmental Recommendation: Staff recommends that the planning Commission recommends that Town Council approve the 6 lot subdivision on a cul-de-sac off Mashie Drive and approve Mashie Drive, LLC’s request for waivers of the sidewalk requirement on Follin Lane and requested lot grade deviation. PROPOSED/SUGGESTED MOTION Planning Commission agenda minutes
